description: Private-sector personnel flow (hire / retire / transfer / acquisition) emitted by legal-entity DIDs. ADR-0028. PII tier 1 — aggregate headcount delta only, no individual employee DID. ADR-0018 k-anonymity: cohort_size >= 5.

sourceDid.description: Legal-entity facade DID (LEI / national-reg / path-based sub-actor). Canonical key is sourceRootDid (ADR-0074).

sourceRootDid.description: ADR-0074 canonical ERC725 root for sourceDid.

counterpartyDid.description: Destination / origin legal-entity facade DID for transfers. Individual DIDs forbidden.

counterpartyRootDid.description: ADR-0074 canonical ERC725 root for counterpartyDid.

headcountDelta.description: Signed delta (positive = inflow, negative = outflow). Aggregate only.

totalHeadcount.description: Optional snapshot headcount at end of fiscalPeriod

cohortSize.description: k-anonymity bucket size when cohortId is set (ADR-0018)
